name: CEdit-Bench
intro: CEdit-Bench 是 LongCat-Image 技术报告提出的中英双语图像编辑基准。它整合并扩展既有编辑基准、补充新策划数据，形成覆盖15个细粒度类别的1,464对样本，并用GPT-4o评价语义一致性、感知质量和总体表现。
build_method: 既有编辑基准整合扩展、新数据策划、中英双语配对、15类细粒度任务标注
metric: 语义一致性(G_SC), 感知质量(G_PQ), 总体得分(G_O)
eval_feature: 双语图像编辑、15类细粒度任务、GPT-4o自动评测
scale: 1,464对中英双语编辑样本，15个类别
drawio_review_note: REDRAW review aligned with arXiv:2512.07584v1 Section 6.5.1 and Figure 21, LongCat-Image repository snapshot f0e4c43c5ef74b011ff71570fbfc2bdffbc9ab06, and CEdit-Bench dataset snapshot d92a2d680a50bd66a5509699c193999b1cac03aa. The diagram preserves integration and expansion of prior editing benchmarks, newly curated data, 1,464 bilingual pairs across 15 categories, the published dataset schema, image-editing inference, GPT-4o automated evaluation, and reported G_SC, G_PQ, and G_O views. Because the public sources do not publish the judge prompt, detailed rubric, operational metric definitions, or aggregation formula, the diagram labels these as undisclosed instead of inventing them.
build_method_en: Integration and Extension of Existing Editing Benchmarks, New Data Curation, Chinese-English Pairing, 15-category Fine-grained Annotation
eval_feature_en: Bilingual Image Editing, 15 Fine-grained Task Categories, GPT-4o Automated Evaluation
intro_en: CEdit-Bench is a bilingual Chinese-English image-editing benchmark introduced in the LongCat-Image technical report. It integrates and extends prior editing benchmarks with newly curated data, yielding 1,464 pairs across 15 fine-grained categories and GPT-4o evaluation of semantic consistency, perceptual quality, and overall performance.
metric_en: Semantic Consistency (G_SC), Perceptual Quality (G_PQ), Overall Score (G_O)
